# Hindam Space (مؤسسة هندام سبيس)

> Excellence in Event & Retail Production | التميز في حلول المعارض والتجهيزات

Hindam Space is a Saudi production and fit-out company delivering turnkey exhibition fabrication, interior solutions, retail shop fitting, indoor/outdoor signage, and commercial vehicle fleet branding across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA).

## Core Services
- **Exhibition Booths & Pavilions (تصميم وتصنيع أجنحة المعارض)**: Custom exhibition booths, corporate pavilions, and interactive displays from concept to handover.
- **Interior Design & Turnkey Fit-Outs (التصميم الداخلي والتشطيبات)**: Commercial offices, reception areas, decorative wood slats, and complete architectural fit-outs.
- **Retail & Shop Fitting (تجهيز المحلات والمتاجر)**: Custom retail display stands, POS counters, and brand-aligned store fixtures.
- **Signage Solutions - Indoor & Outdoor (حلول اللوحات الإعلانية والشاشات)**: 3D illuminated logos, wayfinding totems, arches, and LED digital displays.
- **Commercial Vehicle Branding & Fleet Graphics (تجليد وتجهيز أساطيل المركبات)**: High-durability vinyl fleet wraps and commercial vehicle graphics.

## Key Differentiators
- **In-house manufacturing**: Complete fabrication capabilities for carpentry, metalwork, acrylics, and printing.
- **Rapid on-site installation**: Fast, reliable build and handover teams.
- **Venue compliance**: Full compliance with major Saudi exhibition centers including **Riyadh Front** and **Jeddah Superdome**.
- **Premium material quality**: High-spec delivery across all regions of Saudi Arabia.

## Notable Clients & Projects
- AstraZeneca Medical Information Desk & Exhibition Booth
- Salama Cooperative Insurance Exhibition Pavilion
- Mobil / APSCO Industrial Pavilion
- Petromin / Petro Lube Custom Booth
- Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Group Pavilion & Awareness Arch
- Haramain High Speed Railway Seasonal Arches
- SSI SCHÄFER Office Interior Fit-Out
- Colgate Total & ELLA Retail Activations
